body:
Replaced the optional Omarchy Python status reader with a bounded read-only Rust CLI Focus preview. Current servers supply five ordered preview rows in one snapshot read instead of up to six full-resource requests; reference-only hosts retain bounded detail reads. Three quiet release series on M4/macOS 27 include process startup and show medians of 26–33 ms for Python versus 2.8–3.7 ms for Rust. All 720 selected observations retain title/order/count/availability and request-count checks. The independent Python window launch/focus helper remains.

The final full gate passes 456 tests, including nine native preview regressions and existing confirmation/durability checks. Chromium/WebKit Focus, protocol and code-health checks pass, with final Focus/protocol reruns. The frontend and release daemon/client are rebuilt; the existing manual app preserves 69 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences, epoch and certificate. Trusted HTTPS verifies all 32 served assets, and the new CLI preview matches the running snapshot. The owner's unrelated card edit is preserved. No installed Omarchy/Linux QML or physical-device acceptance is claimed; broader performance and release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Rust Focus widget reader verified with bounded snapshot reads
